title: [FEATURE] Include GitLab Merge Requests on OpenTelemetry metrics
body: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet - [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features) ### Problem Statement When configured, Claude Code pushes OTel metrics, including `claude_code.pull_request.count` (see [docs](https://anthropic.mintlify.app/en/docs/claude-code/monitoring-usage#metrics)). Unfortunately, this metric only accounts for GitHub Pull Requests (using the GitHub CLI `gh`), and **not** for GitLab Merge Requests, which is the Source Control Manager I use in my company. ### Proposed Solution I propose either: 1. Count also GitLab Merge Requests (using [GitLab CLI](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli)) in `claude_code.pull_request.count`. 2. Add an additional metric `claude_code.merge_request.count` for GitLab Merge Requests using the GitLab CLI. With one of the above options instrumented, all Claude Code users using GitLab could also benefit from this OTel metric, both for the public gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab instances. ### Alternative Solutions Unfortunately I couldn't find any useful workaround for this issue. ### Priority High - Significant impact on productivity ### Feature Category Other ### Use Case Example Example scenario: 1. Instrument Claude Code with: * `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT=https://prometheus.example.com/opentelemetry/v1/metrics` * `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf` * `OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=otlp`, 2. Configure Claude Code to use `glab` CLI. 3. Start Claude Code in a local repository with the remote in GitLab. 4. Prompt some changes in the repository and prompt to crete a Merge Request. 5. Verify that Claude code increments `claude_code.merge_request.count`. ### Additional Context With this feature implemented, a user could create a chart like the one below:
